summary: Frontend-only test of 12 new public ARIA SEO/AIO/GEO pages + private dashboard regression. All 12 public routes load without auth with correct title, canonical, >=2 JSON-LD blocks, H1, and FAQ accordions. Demo dashboard has all 7 expected testids and demo-only data. robots.txt and sitemap.xml served with required AI bot rules and all 12 URLs. ProtectedRoute still redirects / to /login when logged out; private pages (/aria-agent/assets, /aria-agent/brain, /aria-agent/weekly-recap) remain accessible after login with admin@demo.com / Demo1234!.

issues: Minor testid-naming mismatch vs review request: spec mentions wrapper testids 'daily-workflow', 'tools-reduced', 'persona-problem' but template uses per-item 'workflow-{i}' and 'tool-{i}'. Content (5 ordered workflow steps, 6 tool chips, 'Who this is for' + 'The problem' sections) is correct — only cosmetic testid naming.

action_items: (Optional, nice-to-have) Add wrapper data-testid='daily-workflow' on <ol> and data-testid='tools-reduced' on the chips container in /app/frontend/src/public/UseCaseTemplate.js; add data-testid='persona-problem' on the who-for/problem grid. Functionally everything works; this only aligns with the literal selector names in the review_request.
critical_code_review_comments: useSEO.js hard-codes BASE_URL = 'https://app.genleadai.com'. Canonicals on preview domain therefore point to prod which is intentional for SEO but double-check before any non-prod deploys that should self-canonicalize.
robots.txt line 22 has lowercase 'user-agent: GPTBot' (inconsistent case) — parsers accept it but worth normalizing.
sitemap.xml lacks <lastmod> tags; adding them helps crawl freshness signals.
AriaHome.js FAQ content is duplicated between FAQ array and faqSchema(FAQ) JSON-LD (expected) — good for GEO/AIO.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (12/12 public pages pass, private regression passes)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Public ARIA ecosystem (12 pages) is live and fully crawlable. All SEO primitives verified: document.title, link[rel=canonical], script[type='application/ld+json'] count >=2, unique H1, FAQ accordions (with data-testid='faq-accordion' on /aria). robots.txt contains OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, GPTBot, Google-Extended, anthropic-ai, Applebot. sitemap.xml lists all 12 URLs at https://app.genleadai.com/... ProtectedRoute integrity preserved — / still redirects to /login; /aria-agent/assets, /brain, /weekly-recap remain authenticated-only. Header CTAs: Sign in -> /login, Book demo -> https://calendly.com/meghaagarwaljain2015/30min. Internal links from /aria to /aria/use-cases/founders, /aria/compare/aria-vs-crm, /aria/demo-dashboard all present. Demo dashboard displays fake data only (Priya, Rohit, Ananya, Karan, Meera, Arjun) with visible demo disclaimer.
rca of the issue: No issues found. Initial test script flagged use-case pages for missing wrapper testids, but verification confirmed content & per-item testids exist. Not a bug, just selector naming discrepancy between review_request wording and implementation.
